title: P1: Grouped delegate rows stop accepting sidebar drops
detail:
Grouped delegate rows stop accepting sidebar drops

native/crates/attn-app/src/sidebar/mod.rs:184

Drag a tile from another desktop onto a visible working delegate in Automations. Hover and release resolve the owning desktop through desktop_at, which searches only ordinary Desktops. Grouping omits this desktop from those lines (sidebar/model.rs:652), so the drop submits no move. Resolve visible automation rows to AutomationRunLine.desktop so the move can promote the desktop after a manual addition.

Reviewed at 90dd08587830aa15e6c2158d10f006dfc325f5e4. Independently confirmed by source trace. Review seed s-ncxe0p.
